Proof in the paper: The powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) pattern of as-made nanowires shows several intense peaks centered at 40.8°, 47.2° and 69.2° (Fig. 1d), which can be readily assigned to the (111), (200) and (220) diffraction planes of a face-centered cubic (fcc) phase. HRTEM image of PtFeNi NWs further reveals their single crystalline nature, as verified by the continuous crystal lattice along the growing direction (Fig. 1e).
